pli-tv-bi-vb-pc58:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc58:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ovadanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc58:1.5: yaṃpi mayaṃ ayye gaccheyyāma ovādassa kāraṇā ayyā chabbaggiyā idheva āgantvā amhe ovadantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc58:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc58:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ovādaṃ na gacchissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc58:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ovādaṃ na gacchantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc58:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ovādaṃ na gacchissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc58:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc58:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī ovādāya vā saṃvāsāya vā na gaccheyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc58:2.1.9: ovādāya vā saṃvāsāya vā na gacchissāmīti dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte āpatti pācittiyassa.
